title: Diagram Design: diagrams like a design studio
notes: Facts checked 2026-10-11. github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design (created 2026-04-16): 49.4k stars, 3.1k forks, MIT; 'Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.'; the agent picks a type, states its plan, writes one .html file; no build step, no JavaScript, no external images; one accent colour for 1-2 focal elements; 1px hairlines, no shadows, radius <= 10px; every coordinate divisible by 4; Instrument Serif / Geist / Geist Mono; variants minimal light, minimal dark, full editorial; 'The highest-quality move is usually deletion.'; brand onboarding from a URL (palette + fonts, WCAG AA 4.5:1 check, fidelity receipt); redraws draw.io, Mermaid, Excalidraw with a ledger of merged/collapsed/dropped; exports SVG, PNG (2x); install: npx skills add cathrynlavery/diagram-design; caveats from the README: quality depends on the model, the same prompt can lay out differently, output is not an editable source, Mermaid fits docs in Git that change often.

lines.text: AI can write a whole app before your coffee cools.
say: AI can write a whole app before your coffee cools.

lines.text: But ask it for one diagram, and you get this.
say: But ask it for one diagram, and you get this.

lines.text: Boxes everywhere. Arrows crossing arrows. Five colours shouting at once.

lines.text: This is Diagram Design, a free, open-source skill for AI coding agents, with over 49,000 GitHub stars.
say: This is Diagram Design, a free, open-source skill for A I coding agents, with over forty-nine thousand GitHub stars.

lines.text: And its trick is one every good designer knows, and almost no AI does.
say: And its trick is one every good designer knows, and almost no A I does.

lines.text: Install it once, then just ask: draw an architecture diagram of my app.
say: Install it once, then just ask: draw an architecture diagram of my app.

lines.text: Your agent picks one of 44 diagram types, tells you its plan, and writes a single HTML file.
say: Your agent picks one of forty-four diagram types, tells you its plan, and writes a single H T M L file.

lines.text: No build step, no JavaScript. One file that opens anywhere.

lines.text: Now, the trick: it's not what it adds. It's what it refuses to add.
say: Now, the trick: it's not what it adds. It's what it refuses to add.

lines.text: One accent colour, saved for the one thing that matters. Hairline borders. Zero shadows. Everything snapped to a 4-pixel grid.
say: One accent colour, saved for the one thing that matters. Hairline borders. Zero shadows. Everything snapped to a four-pixel grid.

lines.text: As its own rulebook says: the highest-quality move is usually deletion.
say: As its own rulebook says: the highest-quality move is usually deletion.

lines.text: And it draws far more than boxes: flowcharts, timelines, Sankeys, Wardley maps, even exploded 3D views of a whole stack.
say: And it draws far more than boxes: flowcharts, timelines, Sankeys, Wardley maps, even exploded three D views of a whole stack.

lines.text: Got an old diagram? Hand it a draw.io, Mermaid or Excalidraw file, and it redraws it, with a receipt of what it merged or dropped.
say: Got an old diagram? Hand it a draw dot I O, Mermaid or Excalidraw file, and it redraws it, with a receipt of what it merged or dropped.

lines.text: Want your company's look? Give it your website, and it pulls your colours and fonts, and checks the text stays readable.

lines.text: It works in Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and more, and exports SVG or PNG for slides and docs.

lines.text: The catch: it's only as good as the model running it, the same prompt can lay out differently, and you get a picture, not an editable canvas.
